title: SN1 Bridges to Nowhere
content:
08:00 - 14:00 | [:smflag-fr:](../../Forces/France/) vs [:smflag-su:](../../Forces/Soviet Union/) | @ [Rastatt](../../Maps/rastatt/Rastatt/)
The screening forces of the 16GC must retreat hurriedly across the Rhine whilst preventing the Soviets from gaining access to the crossing sites. **_Scenario by Joao Lima | Map by William van der Sterren_**

title: SN2 Go West
content:
06:00 - 12:00 | [:smflag-fr:](../../Forces/France/) vs [:smflag-su:](../../Forces/Soviet Union/) | @ [Phalsbourg](../../Maps/phalsbourg/Phalsbourg/)
After finally being able to make an assault crossing of the Rhine, the 11th Tank Division punches from multiple routes at the French forces who must use space to absorb the blows. **_Scenario by Joao Lima | Map by William van der Sterren_**

title: SN3 Tripwire
content:
16:00 - 20:00 | [:smflag-fr:](../../Forces/France/) vs [:smflag-su:](../../Forces/Soviet Union/) | @ [Sarrebourg](../../Maps/sarrebourg/Sarrebourg/)
The 11th Tank Division continues the relentless pressure and the 16GC must make an hasty defence whilst waiting for support from the 1DB to hold the line. **_Scenario by Joao Lima | Map by William van der Sterren_**

title: SN4 Epilogue
content:
08:00 - 14:00 | [:smflag-fr:](../../Forces/France/) vs [:smflag-su:](../../Forces/Soviet Union/) | @ [Arracourt](../../Maps/arracourt/Arracourt/)
As the Soviets continue to aggressively push west, the major concern in NATO's HQ is followed by a perception of opportunity. In the famous battlefield of Arracourt, they decide the open area is conducive to a trap. NATO aims to obliterate the 11th Tank Division that is now conveniently grouped along a single axis of advance. After the Soviets opened the Pandora's box of nuclear weapons, an opportunittic nuclear strike obliterates the 11th Tank Division's spearhead. Showing a merciless disposition, the reminder of the division continues to push forward, using the edges of the radioactive battlefield as flank protection. The battered 16GC is, for a change, on the attack. The 1DB concentrates all resources into the counter-strike as the reminder of the 11th Tank Division finds itself between a radioactive battlefield and the advancing French. **_Scenario by Joao Lima | Map by William van der Sterren_**
